title: First vendor controlled write gate
purpose: Create or verify exactly one first vendor only after TARGET-036C proved the first customer write/reopen route and TARGET-036B proved the Vendor Card route with Vorlage anwenden visible but not clicked.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036C result exists and shows U-CUST-100 / Universaarl Kunde 100 after reopen.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Vendor Card Page 26 shows Nr., Name and Vorlage anwenden before any write.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Vendor Card route is not visible or not safely reopenable.
Vorlage anwenden would be required before the field list is understood.
A customer, item, document, Preview Posting or Posting route appears.
A save/confirm dialog appears with unclear effect.
acceptanceCriteria: At most one vendor is created or verified.
Before/after/reopen screenshots show the vendor route and visible result.
No customer or item is created.
No template is applied unless a nested Smart Decision explicitly approves it.
No setup, document, Preview Posting, Posting, Payment, API shortcut or company switch occurs.
Result JSON states which fields were changed and which remained untouched.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-036D reached the Vendor Card in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE but Business Central blocked vendor creation because number series U-VEND does not allow automatic Default Nos. and the preferred manual U-VEND-100 is not allowed without Manual Nos.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: The next dependency is not Item creation. The first vendor route exposed a precise U-VEND number-series checkbox blocker that must be fixed before continuing master data.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Directly addresses the proven U-VEND Default Nos. / Manual Nos. blocker.
Retry vendor creation only after U-VEND checkbox state is visible after reopen.
Item creation must wait until vendor route is closed and item number-series/base-unit logic is checked.
Foundation blockers remain relevant before any document, preview or posting flow.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It fixes the exact Business Central setup blocker observed on the vendor card instead of moving to unrelated master data.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not change all number series in bulk.
Do not create a vendor inside the checkbox-fit case.
requiredPreparation: Tie Standardnr. and Manuelle Anz. visually to U-VEND using screenshot QA before any checkbox change.

blockedBy: Universaarl Lieferant 100 is not visible after filtered reopen.
result: Controlled Vendor write gate blocked: Universaarl Lieferant 100 is not visible after filtered reopen.
